traditional: A 同 B 都唔 V
jyutping: A tung4 B dou1 m4 V

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese pattern for saying that neither A nor B does or has the stated predicate.

examples.english: Neither my older brother nor I eat spicy food.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 go1 dou1 m4 sik6 laat6 je5
